posts.name: Monospace from Directus
posts.tagline: The governed API layer for every app, person, and agent
posts.description: Monospace sits between enterprise data and everyone who builds on it. Connect any data source, and your developers, business teams, and AI agents get live, read-write access to it. All under the same granular permissions model, with no data copied or moved. Your oldest databases weren't built with AI or modern apps in mind. Monospace generates interfaces directly from them, as they are, introspecting the schema and queries in real time, so they don’t need to be rebuilt.

posts.name: Yedric.ai
posts.tagline: Let users control your SaaS with natural language
posts.description: Your users shouldn't have to learn where every feature lives. Yedric adds an embeddable AI agent to your SaaS that turns natural-language requests into actions your product already knows how to perform. Users simply say what they want done and Yedric handles the interaction. Instead of building and maintaining your own agent experience, developers can make their existing product AI-native in under 30 minutes.

posts.name: Omnia Agent
posts.tagline: The AI Agent that does 95% of your GEO work
posts.description: Every brand needs to show up in AI search. Now yours can, without hiring a GEO expert. Omnia Agent finds the prompts where your competitors are winning, then wins them for you with skills built for GEO. It plugs into the tools you already use, so every action you approve goes live with no extra work.

posts.name: Dots by OpenAI
posts.tagline: Always on agents built to handle everything
posts.description: Dots are always on agents in ChatGPT, powered by GPT‑6 Astra. Each dot has its own cloud computer and browser, connects to over 4,000 apps through plugins, and can work toward your goals 24/7. Message or call your dot in ChatGPT on desktop, web, and mobile, or message it in Slack and Teams. It learns your preferences from feedback and brings you finished work to review. Custom Rules, Activity View, and auto review keep you in control. Rolling out now to Pro and Business Premium.

posts.name: DSH Desktop
posts.tagline: Official app for DeepSeek’s open-source agent harness
posts.description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop is the official Mac and Windows app for DeepSeek’s open-source agent harness. Install it, sign in, and run everyday work, coding, and scheduled tasks locally with the same plugin system as the CLI.

posts.name: statusbar
posts.tagline: a statusbar for any terminal
posts.description: A status bar for any terminal.

posts.name: Bracket
posts.tagline: The memory layer for your business
posts.description: Bracket turns the conversations already happening across your business into a living, continuously updated memory. Connect Gmail, Slack, Figma and GitHub, or add meeting notes and transcripts. Bracket automatically captures requirements, decisions, scope, deliverables, deadlines and changes as they happen. Then ask Bracket about anything that happened or generate replies using the full context. No more manually keeping another tool up to date.

posts.name: Chat.sh
posts.tagline: The help center I built after Intercom's search broke
posts.description: 🎉 Launch day only: $200 off any lifetime deal with code PHLAUNCH ($399 → $199, $799 → $599). Ends Oct 2, 12 AM PT. Most help centers give you a subdomain, a keyword search, and a monthly bill. chat.sh is different: 🔍 AI search that writes the answer and cites the pages it used 📁 Lives in a folder on your own site (yoursite.com/help) 🤖 Every page as markdown for ChatGPT, Claude, and llms.txt 💸 Pay once, no subscription Try it at chat.sh/help. Chat messenger and a support inbox are next.

posts.name: Buddy Drop
posts.tagline: Drop the files, get a live URL in seconds
posts.description: Buddy Drop puts your site or app online in seconds. Just drop your folder, ZIP, or files and choose from a range of free domains or connect your own. Buddy takes care of the rest, from hosting and deployment to previews and versioning. No signup required.

posts.name: America.gov
posts.tagline: Whatever you need from government, start here.
posts.description: America.gov is the simplest, fastest way to get information from the U.S. government. Instead of hunting across agency websites, just ask a question in plain language and get a clear answer. Built by the National Design Studio with the General Services Administration, it brings every federal agency together in one place. Available in English, French, and Spanish. Coming next: apply, enroll, and track progress right in chat.

posts.name: Starlie
posts.tagline: A fast, native Jira client for Mac
posts.description: Starlie is for the Jira work you do every day: find an issue, see what’s going on, update it, leave a comment, move it across the board, and get back to work. Smooth Kanban drag and drop, quick filters, JQL autocomplete, custom fields, Quick Look, reminders, and ⌘K for recent issues. Works with Jira Cloud and self-hosted Jira too. Private by design, with no analytics or tracking. Open coding tasks in Claude Code or Codex with issue context and your local project attached.

posts.name: JevGPT
posts.tagline: A chatbot built on a model that can't write
posts.description: For years we've used LLMs built to write text to make choices. JevGPT returns the favor: a chat app where TypeSafe's Jev, a model built to make choices, writes every reply one multiple-choice word at a time. Does it work? Sort of. Open source.

posts.name: NotchMind
posts.tagline: Put your MacBook notch to work: music, files, timers & more
posts.description: NotchMind turns your MacBook notch into a home for music, files, clipboard history, timers, downloads and 28 everyday tools. Native macOS app, one-time purchase.

posts.name: Phare C1®
posts.tagline: A smoke alarm that detects fire, not toast.
posts.description: Phare C1 is a smoke alarm that sounds for actual emergencies and nothing else. Its multi-sensor array spots fire and CO early and accurately, reduces false alarms, and is backed by detection algorithms that learn and improve to make your home even safer over time. It keeps much-loved features from the Nest Protect (RIP) like early warnings, a night light, and in-app alerts, and adds new ones like air quality monitoring and intruder detection.

posts.name: Polylane
posts.tagline: AI Agent that monitors your code so you're not on call
posts.description: Nobody should be on-call. Polylane makes your software self-operating: AI agents that read your code, watch your infra, and fix production before you wake up.

posts.name: Clarity
posts.tagline: Mute the room, keep the speaker, in real time
posts.description: Real-time speech enhancement and target speaker extraction for voice agents. Clarity-1 strips out background noise and other people talking on a live call, so your agent hears only the caller. Streams as audio arrives. Hear the before/after on our site.

posts.name: Basedash chat dashboard preview
posts.tagline: One prompt. A whole dashboard, live in your chat.
posts.description: Basedash chat now builds whole dashboards from one prompt — KPIs, charts, tables, filters, and tabs — and previews them live right in the conversation. Ask for "a sales dashboard with pipeline, win rate, and revenue by rep" and it lands inline, ready to use. Change the date filter, switch tabs, then open it as a full dashboard when it looks right. Sales, support, product, finance, and ops can all start from a sentence. One prompt. A whole dashboard, live in your chat.

posts.name: Firetower
posts.tagline: Run coding agents on your own servers, from anywhere
posts.description: Run coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on infrastructure you control and manage them from desktop or mobile. It's open source, self-hostable, and built in Rust.

posts.name: Vitra.ai
posts.tagline: Agentic content platform to create and localize content
posts.description: Stop switching tools! Vitra.ai Universe does the work of 12 tools in one place: create, translate and personalize video, images, docs and audio in 100+ languages. Dub with lip-sync, translate designs from Figma, Canva and Adobe, and adapt every creative to every size. AI agents in Vitra Flow run your workflows end to end, & your team approves. Brand kits, translation memory, & style guides keep every output on-brand. The future of Autonomous Content Operations is here Start free, no credit card.

posts.name: Rate.fm
posts.tagline: Letterboxd for music, on iPhone
posts.description: - Rate songs and albums out of 10. - Write reviews. - Keep a listening diary. - Follow friends to see their ratings. - Follow critics and publications. - Reviews are also available in the app. - Native iOS 26+ with Liquid Glass, Apple Music and Spotify integrations, synced lyrics on the player with Genius annotations, widgets, and a live activity to see what friends thought. - Free, badge subscription to support the app

posts.name: Formalini
posts.tagline: Business or Personal, Put Your Documents to Work very simply
posts.description: Formalini turns any document, photo, scan, or handwritten note into clean, structured data — JSON, Excel, tables, and more — in seconds. 📁 Personal Vault keeps your important personal documents, receipts and others organized in one place — automatically extracting the information you need. 🏢 For businesses, Formalini connects with UiPath, SAP, Salesforce and other enterprise workflows. 🤖 And with the MCP server, AI agents can interact with your documents and structured data programmatically.

posts.name: Twin
posts.tagline: a tiny buddy that lives on your Mac
posts.description: Twin is a local first AI buddy that floats on your Mac desktop: it remembers your day, catcheTwin is a free, open source buddy that floats on your Mac. It catches you up on texts, remembers your calendar, talks back by voice, and nudges you before you forget. Your data lives in a local DuckDB file. Bring your own Claude, GPT, Gemini or Grok key.s you up on your texts, talks back by voice, and nudges you before you forget, all on-device with DuckDB. No cloud, no accounts.

posts.name: Lume
posts.tagline: Notes that appear with a mouse shake
posts.description: Lume is a native Windows notes app (WinUI 3, no Electron) that stays hidden until you need it. Shake your mouse or press a shortcut, write, and press Esc — it’s gone. Beyond quick notes: a scratchpad that does maths as you type, freehand drawing on notes, and local-first storage with optional OneDrive sync. Free for up to 20 notes. Reading, search and export always stay free.

posts.name: StayLokal
posts.tagline: Private file tools that run on your device.
posts.description: StayLokal is a local-first file utility desk for PDFs, images, video, audio, and more.

posts.name: Otter Vault
posts.tagline: Catch API keys the moment they appear, encrypted locally
posts.description: Otter Vault catches API keys the moment they appear and keeps them encrypted on your own device. Watch the demo and leave a reply, no account needed.

posts.name: OpenCompanion
posts.tagline: Start, watch and answer AI coding CLIs from one desktop app
posts.description: When you run Claude Code, Codex CLI or OpenCode in several folders at once, each session stops now and then to ask for permission, and you only find out when you look at its terminal. OpenCompanion starts those sessions, lists them on one screen, tells you when one is waiting, and lets you answer from the desktop or from your phone on the same Wi-Fi. No account, no cloud server, no telemetry. Open source (MIT), for Windows, Linux and macOS.

posts.name: Stardrift for iOS
posts.tagline: The AI travel assistant in your pocket
posts.description: Stardrift is the AI travel assistant that lives in your pocket. Before your trip, it helps you plan your dream trip day-by-day and build an organized wishlist of places to go. While you're on your trip, it recommends nearby places you might like, collects all the logistical details you need in one place, and alerts you to anything you need to know. You can download it today from the App Store!

posts.name: ChainSnip
posts.tagline: Accountant's Proof of the Wallet's Balance
posts.description: Automatically capture and archive blockchain explorer pages with wallet balances at month-end. Timestamped, verifiable proof for crypto accountants, auditors, and financial professionals.

posts.name: AuthMonster
posts.tagline: The 2FA app you actually enjoy using
posts.description: Most two-factor authentication apps are built almost as an afterthought by big companies like Google and Microsoft, with a clunky, bare-bones experience. AuthMonster takes a different approach: we put user experience front and center, wrapped in a lovable brand starring Toki, your token-eating monster. Under the hood, you get painless migration from apps like Google Authenticator and LastPass, biometric locking, and a donation-based model instead of paywalled features."

posts.name: Kholo
posts.tagline: Take a car, a rocket, even your body apart in 3D
posts.description: School tells children what happens. Kholo lets them open it. Pull a car, a rocket or the human body apart in 3D. Read real Python line by line before running it. Work through English stories at your own level. Build something from parts your local shop sells. Ages 6–14, mapped to the NCERT syllabus.

posts.name: Semitexa
posts.tagline: The PHP framework your AI agent can actually inspect
posts.description: Semitexa is an open-source PHP 8.4 framework for long-running Swoole servers and AI-assisted development. A project graph lets you (or your AI agent) query routes, dependencies and blast radius before editing. Pages render on the server and arrive in stages, with deferred blocks and live SSE updates and no second frontend. ORM, tenancy and queues are built in, and traces plus targeted tests verify every change. Explore 81 live demo routes, with the source next to each one.

posts.name: Helo
posts.tagline: An independent email API from former Postmark folks
posts.description: Helo is an email API built for developers and platforms that send on behalf of their customers. Contain bad senders before they drag down deliverability, let customers send from their own domains, and keep stats, unsubscribes, and credentials separate per tenant. It also covers the fundamentals: REST API and SMTP, SDKs in popular languages, separate transactional and broadcast infrastructure, and usage-based pricing starting at just $0.00035 per email—all features included.

posts.name: Typestream
posts.tagline: Type like a human without touching the keyboard
posts.description: Typestream replays your text into any Mac app character by character — natural speed, thinking pauses, real hesitation. Perfect for demos, recordings, and talks.

posts.name: Scape
posts.tagline: Team document collab with your terminal harness (cc, codex)
posts.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode across unlimited isolated git worktrees on your Mac. Build automations you own, and let Argus orchestrate the fleet.

posts.name: rhun
posts.tagline: A small, fast code editor written in assembly
posts.description: A small code editor for Windows, Linux and macOS. Written in assembly, with a built-in terminal, Git diffs, fuzzy search, Vim mode and a panel for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Free and open source.

posts.name: UTTER IN
posts.tagline: Say it once and your AI assistant plans the rest
posts.description: UTTER IN turns one voice note into reminders, calendar events and saved places. Say three or four things in one breath, in English or Arabic (Gulf, Egyptian and Levantine dialects included), and it splits them into separate cards with times, people and locations. Nothing is saved until you approve each card. Plans can go straight to Google, Outlook or Apple Calendar. Free plan forever, no card needed. On iPhone, Android and the web.

posts.name: ShareCube
posts.tagline: Share what your agents make, get feedback on the exact line
posts.description: ShareCube gives your AI agents a place to publish. From Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client, your agent posts an HTML or Markdown artifact to a project and hands you a link, not a wall of chat. Your team comments on the exact sentence, @mentions each other and resolves threads. The agent reads that feedback and ships the next version. Every save is versioned. Share privately, with your org, or publicly: anyone with the link can read it, no account needed.

posts.name: Brink
posts.tagline: Your Notion pages and tasks, one hover away on your Mac
posts.description: Brink is a quiet black notch on your Mac's screen edge. Hover it to peek at your Notion pages and tasks, tick things off in place, capture a task from any app with a hotkey, and see what's due today. Free and open source.

posts.name: Cura
posts.tagline: Your AI travel agent that plans, books, and adapts
posts.description: Cura is your personal AI travel agent that plans, and manages trips in one place. Tell it where you want to go and Cura builds your itinerary, finds flights and stays worth considering with clear reasoning, and handles check-ins and changes. It learns how you travel, so future trip planning takes just one line. When things get complicated, human travel advisors step in. Unlike booking tools, Cura takes action for you.

posts.name: Prefer
posts.tagline: The execution layer for AEO
posts.description: AEO should not be another dashboard. Prefer works at the execution layer, helping brands understand how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity talk about them, identify where they are missing, and take action to improve their visibility. Turn AI search insights into action with autonomous agents. Less reporting. More doing.

posts.name: Vorker
posts.tagline: AI Coworker Running Your Small Business
posts.description: Vorker.ai is an AI coworker that gets the job done in your company. Streamline your small business operations and boost productivity.

posts.name: UI Arc
posts.tagline: Open-source React components that feel finished
posts.description: Arc is a library of React components and blocks with motion built in. The core is free and open source (MIT) and installs with the shadcn CLI, so the code lives in your project and you can change anything. Every component has Markdown docs, llms.txt and an MCP server, so Claude Code or Cursor can pick and install the right piece instead of inventing one. Pro adds showpiece motion components and full app screens. New components ship every day.

posts.name: chiliad — Google Ads Script Management
posts.tagline: Monitor and manage Google Ads scripts across every account
posts.description: The first dedicated SaaS platform for PPC agencies and freelancers to manage, deploy, and monitor Google Ads scripts across teams and accounts. Paste one loader per account; code and per-account config live in chiliad and apply on the next run, MCC-aware. Every run is logged, with Slack or email alerts when one fails. 130+ ready-made scripts library, almost all free. Plus a MCP connector for Claude and AI Agents: describe a script in plain language and Claude writes, deploys and debugs it.

posts.name: Gatling.chat
posts.tagline: The Turbo Messenger for LinkedIn
posts.description: The turbo messenger for LinkedIn: split inboxes, follow-up reminders, manual-send sequences, and keyboard-first triage. No automated sending.

posts.name: Neutrino design engine
posts.tagline: 100% custom website quality, 1% of the time and cost.
posts.description: Neutrino was made to end the trade-off between launching fast and launching proud. It’s a perfected web design engine that delivers a premium UX out of the box and enables you to go live today. How? By eliminating the need to shorten texts, crop images to arbitrary aspect ratios, and other unnecessary grunt work we accepted as normal part of publishing workflow.

posts.name: Kardinal
posts.tagline: Route optimization API built for developers and their agents
posts.description: Kardinal is a route optimization API rebuilt for AI agents to call directly: typed SDKs, docs an agent can actually read. Built on 10 years of production route optimization, for the constraints that break most "demo" solvers (e.g. capacity-gated returns, self-closing consolidation loops, key-holder-only access windows). Test it entirely on your own: free tier, no sales call, no quote. The most complete API on the market: 93% of constraints covered, per our 2026 benchmark of 11 APIs.

posts.name: Git Context
posts.tagline: Switch Git identities without the config headache
posts.description: Ever committed with the wrong email or SSH key? Git Context makes switching between work, personal, and client GitHub or GitLab identities simple. Switch your global Git author and SSH key in one click, see your active profile in the macOS menu bar, and use a keyboard shortcut to switch quickly. Verify SSH authentication, detect configuration issues, and restore backed-up settings. Private keys stay local. Repository overrides and HTTPS credentials remain separate.

posts.name: OpenGraph+ for Mac
posts.tagline: Preview & debug Open Graph for any website, even localhost
posts.description: Most Open Graph checkers need a crawler to fetch your page, so they can't see localhost. OpenGraph+ for Mac can. Point it at localhost, staging, or any website and see the link card 22 platforms will show. Inspect the tags and copy what's missing. Free. No account.

posts.name: StackHandoff
posts.tagline: Move machines. Keep your dev workspace.
posts.description: StackHandoff is a peer-to-peer desktop app that lets developers continue an active workspace on another computer. It captures projects, Git branches, uncommitted changes, apps, runtimes, tools, and environment requirements as a portable manifest—then securely restores them on the destination machine. No cloud account, no central server, and every restore step is reviewed before it runs. Mac ↔ Windows, encrypted by design, open source.

posts.name: musen
posts.tagline: Direct your personal radio with text, voice, or a photo.
posts.description: musen is AI Radio: a continuous personal Live Radio experience shaped around what you want to hear and how you listen. Press play, then direct the radio with text, voice or a picture while musen keeps the stream moving around your moment.

posts.name: MailTag
posts.tagline: Auto-labeled inbox your agents can safely act on
posts.description: Meet Mailtag — inbox management built for the agent era. Describe how you want your emails categorized in plain English, and Mailtag automatically tags them. Clean up your inbox with bulk unsubscribe, subscription metrics, archiving, and more. For AI agents, Mailtag gives you an MCP with granular control over which emails, categories, time ranges, and even email content they can access. No more personal data sent to corporates without intent. Less inbox chaos. More control.

posts.name: ShopiFrame
posts.tagline: Build an ecommerce store in Framer
posts.description: Create a store without the design limitations of Shopify themes, while keeping your products, inventory, payments, and orders in Shopify. Get started with free and customizable templates: https://shopiframe.com/#Template

posts.name: Sienna
posts.tagline: Premium galleries for photographers
posts.description: Sienna is the gallery delivery platform for photographers and videographers: unlimited photos and videos, your own art direction, your own domain, and galleries that open in an instant.

posts.name: BrandTower
posts.tagline: A 130-floor skyscraper where every window is a startup
posts.description: Fly through a 3D skyscraper at night. Each of its 1,050 windows holds one brand: logo, name, link. The first 50 windows are free, with a do-follow backlink and no expiry. Higher floors cost more, the spire is auction-only, and a nightly drone show lights it up.

posts.name: New Getting Started Experience for AWS
posts.tagline: Sign up, connect your coding agent, ship on AWS, limit spend
posts.description: We rebuilt the getting started experience for AWS. Sign up with Google, GitHub, or Apple. Most new users won't need a credit card, plus get $100 in free credits. Paste a prompt to connect your coding agent, and it deploys to AWS following best practices. Invite collaborators by email with permissions handled for you. Set a monthly spend limit per project: if you hit it, the project pauses instead of billing past the cap. When you need more, turn on advanced AWS features with no migration.

posts.name: Maven AI 2.0
posts.tagline: AI agents that turn your data into answers and action
posts.description: Maven AI 2.0 is your AI analytics assistant inside Usermaven. Ask questions about your data in plain English. Find out which campaigns bring customers, why signups dropped, where users get stuck, or how people use your product. Get clear answers, charts, recommendations, and even complete dashboards. You can also upload files, ask questions by voice, or set up AI Agents to analyze your data regularly and send you the findings automatically.

posts.name: OrcaSheets AI Dashboards
posts.tagline: Talk to your data and get live dashboards you can share
posts.description: Ask your data questions in plain English, pin the charts and pivot tables you like, and watch your dashboard come together as you go. It updates whenever your sheets do, and anyone with the link sees live data without a login or a paid seat. Free to start, with unlimited dashboards and 150 AI questions a month.

posts.name: meraGEO
posts.tagline: See if ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini recommend your brand
posts.description: meraGEO shows whether ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini actually name your brand when someone asks for a recommendation in your category, and which competitors they name instead. The scan is free and needs no signup. Paid plans rescan every week, email you when the answers change, and ship a fix report: a custom llms.txt, an AI-optimized FAQ, comparison pages, and citation targets.

posts.name: JSango
posts.tagline: The simplest way to build your next backend
posts.description: JSango is a batteries-included, high-performance TypeScript backend framework inspired by Django's convention-over-configuration philosophy, featuring an ORM, SegRadix router (>7.7M ops/sec), auto-generated React admin console, 2FA auth, and background queues.

posts.name: Comment Letter
posts.tagline: Answer your plan check letter in minutes, not days
posts.description: Turn your plan check correction letter into drafted responses and a clear work plan with just few clicks. First, upload the letter and your submitted drawings. Comment Letter checks each comment against your city's building codes and your plans, flags likely violations and opportunities to push back, and drafts responses with citations. Share the report, assign comments, ask follow-up questions in chat, and export the letter with responses under each comment. No subscription required.

posts.name: SizeFoto
posts.tagline: Passport and ID photos measured to your country's rules
posts.description: Take a photo against any wall. SizeFoto removes the background, measures your head against your country's official rules and gives you a file to upload plus a sheet to print. 60+ countries and document types (passport, visa, ID, driving licence, residence permit, baby photos) in 10 languages. Each country page links the government source it follows. Everything runs in your browser: free, no account, and your photo is never uploaded.

posts.name: Buyaplanet.lol
posts.tagline: Own land on a planet that doesn’t exist. Yet.
posts.description: Welcome to your new home planet. 🪐 Earth is getting crowded, so we decided to do something about it. buyaplanet.lol lets you claim a piece of a fictional planet and make it yours. Pick a plot, upload your logo, and officially become a planetary landowner. There’s no mortgage, no property tax, and thankfully, no HOA. The only catch? The planet doesn’t exist. Yet. Welcome to the future of real estate.

posts.name: Sapienta
posts.tagline: Raise curious, knowledgeable kids.
posts.description: Sapienta gives parents a few ideas a day, picked for their child's age and interests, from science and nature to history, art and music. Pick one together, read a short story written at the right level, then tell Sapienta what clicked. Interests become bridges to new subjects (dinosaurs lead to geology, music to math). No endless feed, no solo screen time. Built for parents and kids ages 4 to 10 to explore the world together.

posts.name: Loopency
posts.tagline: The operations platform for growing B2B companies
posts.description: Loopency is a business operating system that adapts to how your company actually works. Define your own entities, relationships, processes, rules, approvals and automations instead of forcing your business into fixed software. AI agents work inside that operating model to monitor operations, spot issues, prepare actions and move work forward, while your team stays in control. Built for growing manufacturers, distributors and B2B companies.

posts.name: Bellringer
posts.tagline: Alarm for events, you don't miss anything
posts.description: Bellringer turns the meetings in every calendar on your iPhone and iPad into real alarms that ring through Silent mode and Focus. You can setup rules for upcoming events that you have not seen yet or invited just now. Like i am optional skip the alarm. Hit alarm for any upcoming meetings before 10 minutes.

posts.name: WebRebuilder
posts.tagline: AI web rebuilder that updates, blogs, & optimizes for you.
posts.description: Unlike prompt-to-app tools like Lovable that leave you stranded with credit-burning debug loops and static single-page outputs, WebRebuilder is a managed AI agent platform that rebuilds and continuously maintains your site. What makes it stand out: • Auto-Blogging: Fully working blog with initial posts + hands-free ongoing content. • Always-On Maintenance: Continuous SEO, security, & accessibility auto-adjustments.

posts.name: Recourse
posts.tagline: One support agent on WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, email and phone
posts.description: One agent on WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram, Teams, Discord, SMS, email, a phone number, your own widget and inside Intercom's messenger. Not a chat box on a website. It answers from your pages, your Notion and tickets your team already closed, and shows which page it used. It can look up a Stripe charge or a Shopify order, read only. When a person takes the thread it goes to one of nine desks, and their reply goes back out on the channel the customer used. Self-hosted. MIT.

posts.name: Viewport Kit – Chrome Extension
posts.tagline: Resize the viewport, not the window, to exact pixel sizes.
posts.description: A Chrome extension that resizes a web page's viewport to 1080p, 720p, og:image, or any custom size in one click, then lets you take screenshots or record it right away. Unlike window resizers, it measures the actual viewport, so you get exactly the size you asked for. Pro adds full-page capture that stitches the whole page into one PNG without repeating sticky headers, WebM/MP4 recording with page audio and auto-scroll, and unlimited custom sizes. One-time purchase, no subscription.

posts.name: Pennyweight
posts.tagline: Keep your human happy. They hate bookkeeping.
posts.description: Keep your human happy. They hate bookkeeping. Traditional accounting software was built for humans to operate – then AI was added as an afterthought. Pennyweight starts from the other end: a ledger whose primary user is your AI. Connect any assistant you already use. What's new: it remembers. Every decision is stored with its reasoning, your corrections are pinned so no future session undoes them, and every AI action is auditable. Other tools reset each chat. Ours picks up where it left off.

posts.name: GhostReply Agency
posts.tagline: Your personal reply guy on X, from $29 a month
posts.description: GhostReply Agency posts daily replies from your own X account, in your voice, under the posts your market already reads. Access goes through X's delegate feature, so no password is shared. Slide to pick the volume: 3-5 replies a day for $29/month, up to 100+.

posts.name: AskedTheAI
posts.tagline: 4 AI models answer your shopping question. A human checks.
posts.description: Ask an AI chatbot what to buy and you get one confident answer. Ask another and you often get a different one. AskedTheAI puts the same shopping question to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok, keeps their raw answers, and shows where they agree and where they split. Then a human editor checks every pick on Amazon before we link it, and removes anything unavailable or not as described. Free, no signup.

posts.name: TikTok UGC Creator Finder
posts.tagline: Find and vet TikTok UGC creators by niche, free
posts.description: Search a live index of TikTok UGC creators by niche, follower band and country, then vet them with a short checklist before you reach out: recent posts, disclosed paid work, portfolio link, fit with your product. No signup for the search preview; the full profiles with verified emails live inside UGC Agent.
